tasks.subject: Phase 1: Operational cleanup
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Finish operational cleanup.
**Done:** shared dev credentials replaced, admin promoted on development, README marks seed credentials local-only.
**Acceptance Criteria (remaining, owner action):** Neon password rotated in GitHub and Render; past Sentry events on development reviewed; test verification and reset emails confirmed delivered.
**Verify:** Owner confirms; /health returns 200 after rotation.
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "mechanical", "userGate": true, "acceptanceCriteria": ["Neon password rotated", "Sentry events reviewed", "Test emails confirmed"]}
```

tasks.subject: Phase 2: Roles and access
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Enforce roles and tighten cross-user access.
**Acceptance Criteria:** RolesGuard + @Roles; publishing admin-only; admin can edit, unpublish and delete any template; non-admins cannot edit published templates; GET /users/:id self-or-admin; created_by null for non-owner non-admin viewers; leaderboard user_id replaced by is_me; users.disabled_at with admin disable/enable, enforced on login, JWT and sockets; scripts/promote-admin.ts; cross-user e2e matrix; schema doc and migration.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Non-admin publish returns 403", "Admin moderation works", "Cross-user matrix passes", "Disabled user is rejected"]}
```

tasks.subject: Phase 3: Email identity
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Unique normalized email, email verification, password reset and change via Resend.
**Acceptance Criteria:** EMAIL_SENDER port and Resend adapter; RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, APP_BASE_URL required on staging/production only; normalizeEmail in register, login and forgot-password; migration lowercases emails, adds CHECK, aborts on collision without merging; users.email_verified_at backfilled for existing users; users.token_version in JWT, checked by JwtStrategy and gateway; auth_tokens table storing SHA-256 hashes only, single use, reset 1h, verification 24h, one send per account per 5 minutes; POST /auth/forgot-password (uniform 202, async send), /auth/reset-password (sets email_verified_at, invalidates tokens and sessions), /auth/change-password (requires current password), /auth/verify-email, /auth/resend-verification; register returns uniform 202; unverified users get 403 on AI, connectors and planning jobs; tokens in URL fragment and POST body only; audit events; frontend guide updated. EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED flag: default off on development/test, always on for staging/production. No domain exists yet, so dev delivers only to the Resend account owner via onboarding@resend.dev; a verified domain is required before staging or production.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e; then real mail test on dev to a user-controlled inbox.
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Case variants collide", "Uniform forgot-password response", "Expired, reused and tampered tokens rejected", "Reset ends old sessions", "Only hashes stored", "Unverified users blocked from AI, connectors and planning"]}
```

tasks.subject: Phase 4: Limits
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Bound non-AI input sizes, responses and storage per user. AI quota and AI input limits moved to docs/plans/2026-11-06-ai-rework.md (slices 3 and 5).
**Acceptance Criteria:** @MaxLength and ArrayMaxSize across DTOs (must accept the existing 17-section template); capped pagination on GET /templates; per-user caps on documents, sections per document, versions, templates; scope enum with global admin-only; doc_type validated; leaderboard XP capped per day. Needs user decisions first: storage cap numbers, and whether registration stays open.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Oversized input rejected", "Pagination capped", "Caps enforced"]}
```

tasks.subject: Phase 5: Auth hardening
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Finish session and login hardening.
**Acceptance Criteria:** Sockets disconnected at token expiry; logout bumps token_version; per-account login throttle; dummy bcrypt compare for unknown emails; boot fails on staging/production if CORS is * or JWT_SECRET equals the .env.example placeholder; password capped at 72 bytes on register, reset and change; timing on /auth/register made uniform for new and existing addresses.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Socket ends at expiry", "Logout invalidates token", "Login throttled per account", "Unsafe production config fails boot"]}
```

tasks.subject: Phase 6: Remaining items
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Close the remaining smaller items. Done in code; per-tier broker credentials remain an operator action (documented in docs/security.md, not yet applied on development or later tiers). Generic provider errors and the featureType allowlist moved to docs/plans/2026-11-06-ai-rework.md.
**Acceptance Criteria:** Audit events for template publish, update, delete, admin actions and role changes; per-tier broker credentials with restricted queue permissions and trust boundary documented in docs/security.md; Swagger off on staging; doc-type check on apply; connector reconnect reviewed for leftover Composio accounts and fixed if needed; Postgres TLS verifies the server certificate (typeorm data source and app config currently use rejectUnauthorized false), confirming Neon CA compatibility; non-admin template update made conditional on is_published at the DB so a concurrent publish can't be overwritten.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Audit events recorded", "Swagger off on staging", "Connector reconnect resolved"]}
```

tasks.subject: Template content: key points and guidance
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Store section keyPoints and guidance for the starter templates.
**Acceptance Criteria:** template_sections gains key_points (jsonb) and guidance (text), both nullable, with migration and schema doc; the fields carried through every layer: domain TemplateSection and TemplateSectionData, TemplateSectionInput and toTemplateSectionData, ORM entity and toDomain mapping, request DTO with class-validator and Swagger, response DTO as snake_case key_points and guidance; unit and e2e tests proving a round trip. The ValidationPipe whitelist strips unknown fields without an error, so a PATCH sent before deploy reports success and loses the content. Decided 2026-11-06: apply does not copy them into the document; they stay on the template for the frontend to show as guidance. After the deploy to development, each of the five templates PATCHed as an admin from docs/plans/2026-11-06-template-content.json, then read back and compared. PATCH replaces sections wholesale, so section ids change.
**Verify:** npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
```json:metadata
{"modelTier": "standard", "verifyCommand": "npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Fields stored and returned", "All five templates match the JSON"]}
```
